streamCache.title: Offline cache
streamCache.autoToggleHint: After an online song plays, save its audio so it plays offline next time. Uses bandwidth and disk.
streamCache.playbackHint: Remote songs play from this LRU cache after the first load. Manual downloads stay saved separately and are never evicted by this limit.
streamCache.permanentHint: Uploaded, generated, downloaded, cover, memory, and gallery files referenced by the library. These are not evicted by playback cache limits.

playlistImport.title: Import playlist
playlistImport.orAddToExisting: Or add to an existing set
playlistImport.downloadHint: Save every track for offline play. Uses bandwidth and disk.

player.streamNeedsAccess: This song needs you to log in to that source (VIP / members only)

dj.writing: DJ is writing the next track…

nowPlaying.videoUnsupported: This video format can't play on this device (e.g. MKV). Try MP4 or WebM.

lyrics.searchPrompt: No lyrics yet — search LRCLIB for them.

lyricsSettings.title: Lyrics
lyricsSettings.wordByWordHint: Fills each word as it's sung when the lyrics have word-level timing.
lyricsSettings.showTranslationHint: Show a translated line under the lyrics, when the source has one.
lyricsSettings.showRomanizationHint: Show pronunciation (romaji / pinyin) under the lyrics, when available.
lyricsSettings.colorCoverHint: Follows the cover color used by the visualizer.

track.typeToCreateSet: Type a name to create a set
track.empty: Nothing here yet — start a set and the DJ will fill it.
track.deleteConfirmBody: This removes it from all sets and deletes its audio, cover, and memories. This can’t be undone.

drop.addTitle: Drop to add to your set
drop.addSubtitle: Audio & video become tracks — drop anywhere on screen
drop.imageDragSubtitle: Release to set it as a cover or background
drop.imageModalBody: As the cover for “{{title}}”, or add it to its background slideshow.
drop.galleryModalBody: Nothing is playing — add it to the global background slideshow gallery.
drop.dropAsCover: Drop to set this song's cover
drop.dropAsTrackBackground: Drop outside the cover to add this song's background

background.title: Background
background.slideshowHint: The slideshow prefers a song's bound backgrounds, falling back to the global gallery below.
background.galleryFallbackHint: When a track has no slideshow or cover of its own, use the global gallery below.
background.galleryDesc: Images for the slideshow background, shared across songs (a song's own backgrounds take priority). Upload or paste several at once.
background.trackSlideshowDesc: Images bound only to this song. They appear in the Now Playing blank/background area when slideshow mode is on.
background.trackSlideshowEmpty: No backgrounds for this track yet. Drop an image outside the cover area, or add one here.
background.immersiveIdleHint: On Now Playing, fade out the header and dock after a few idle seconds. Move the mouse to bring them back.
background.coverCroppedHint: Covers display the square you cropped; turn off to show the full image. The original is always kept.

flow.title: Flow background
flow.intro: A calm flowing-light backdrop that melts your cover colors together.
flow.useAsBackground: Use flow as the Now-Playing background
flow.sourceHint: “Follow cover” uses the current cover's palette and falls back to your custom colors when there's no cover.
flow.customColorsHint: Used for “Custom”, and as the fallback when a cover has no usable colors.
flow.enableHint: Adds a flowing-light layer above the background image/video and below the visualizer — they stack, not replace.

visualizer.title: Visualizer
visualizer.openSettingsHint: Right-click or long-press to open settings
visualizer.previewOnlyHint: Temporarily hides the cover, controls, queue, and dock so full-screen effects are easier to judge.
visualizer.backgroundPreviewHint: These preview toggles reset when the panel closes, so the player returns to its normal layers.
visualizer.useCoverColorHint: When the current track has cover art, its dominant color takes priority over the theme accent.
visualizer.asBackgroundHint: Overlays the live visualizer above the background image or slideshow (uses more power).
visualizer.idleOnlyHint: On Now Playing, fade out the cover, controls, queue, header, and dock after a few idle seconds so only the background visualizer remains.
visualizer.memoryOverlayHint: When only the background and spectrum remain, surface your memories one at a time as a top popover — timestamp-pinned ones at their moment, the rest filling the quiet gaps.

annotation.notePlaceholder: What does this one mean to you? (searchable)

settings.autoFetchLyricsHint: Look up time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB for your uploads. This sends the track title and artist to lrclib.net.
settings.smoothScrollHint: Glide the mouse wheel through long lists, queues, and album pages instead of jumping line by line.
settings.smoothScrollHintMac: Off by default on macOS — the trackpad already scrolls smoothly. Turn it on if you use an external mouse.
settings.smoothScrollReducedMotion: Currently off because your system has Reduce Motion enabled.
settings.lyricsSourceHint: Where to look up lyrics. NetEase Cloud Music has a large CJK catalogue; songs streamed from NetEase always use it (exact match).
settings.appIconHint: Changes the browser tab icon and the running dock / taskbar icon. The installed icon updates on the next app update.
settings.appIconBrowserHint: Changes the browser tab icon. Desktop dock / taskbar icons update in the Electron app.
settings.llmNoEnabled: No providers with a key yet
settings.cloudNote: MUZERO stays local-first for storage; only music rendering calls this cloud API, with your key. The request/response mapping lives in src/musicgen/cloud-provider.ts — adjust it for your chosen provider.
settings.localNote: MUZERO is local-first: tracks, audio, and these settings live in your browser's IndexedDB on this device. API keys are stored locally and sent only to the provider you choose — never to us.
settings.costHint: ≈ {{song}} per song · continuous ≈ {{hourly}}/hr (one song every ~3 min)
settings.costUnknown: Cost depends on your provider's pricing.
settings.modelHint: auto = latest model; or enter a specific version id.
settings.deviceAvatarHint: Upload a square avatar. When profile publishing is on, Sync uploads it to writable owner/trusted R2 drives.
settings.deviceProfilePublish: Publish this device profile when syncing
settings.deviceProfilePublishHint: Only owner/trusted writable drives can receive this name, generated avatar seed, and uploaded avatar.
settings.cloudPreviewEmpty: No manifest has been published yet. Run Sync now to publish this drive.
settings.cloudReadOnlyNote: Public links import as read-only stream sets. Media stays remote until cached.
settings.cloudAutoSyncPaused: Auto sync is paused. Run Sync now or change this setting to resume.
settings.cloudCorsHint: Use this on the bucket when running MUZERO in a browser.
settings.cloudMultiWriterHint: Multiple devices can sync to this drive. Sync now is bidirectional: it first pulls other devices' edits into your sets (new tracks, removals, renames), then publishes the merged result — both sides' additions are kept, removals propagate safely, and conflicting writes re-merge and retry automatically.
settings.cloudPresenceHint: Optional. Only owner/trusted writable drives may publish this device's current track.
settings.cloudPresenceCost: Writes are throttled to track/state changes and at most one heartbeat per minute.
settings.cloudOwnerSimplifiedHint: Paste your R2 S3 endpoint, access key, secret, and public bucket URL. MUZERO uses the whole bucket — no prefix needed.
settings.cloudTrustedSetupHint: After this device is configured, copy a trusted-device setup link from its drive card and paste it on another device. The link contains write credentials, so only send it to your own trusted devices.
settings.cloudOwnerNoBuckets: No buckets found for these credentials.
settings.cloudOwnerValidated: Owner drive validated and saved locally.
settings.addDriveDesc: Connect your own Cloudflare R2 bucket, or paste a setup/share link from another device.
settings.addDriveFolderHint: Use only this path inside the bucket. Leave empty to use the whole bucket.
settings.addDriveSharedHint: Paste a public read-only link, or a trusted-device setup link copied from your own drive card.
settings.addDriveWriteSectionHint: Required for bidirectional owner sync. Public read-only setup can use the Shared link tab without these credentials.
settings.addDrivePublicSectionHint: This public bucket URL is used for manifest/media reads in browsers and on other devices.
settings.addDriveGuidePublicReadBody: Public playback and import only need the public bucket URL or manifest URL plus bucket CORS. They do not need Access Key ID or Secret Access Key.
settings.addDriveGuideCorsBody: Add the recommended MUZERO CORS JSON to the bucket so browser fetch, audio playback, and preview checks can read objects.
settings.addDriveGuideWriteBody: Owner/trusted bidirectional sync needs R2 S3 API credentials. Cloudflare creates them from an R2 API token, then MUZERO stores the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key locally.
settings.addDriveGuideSharedBody: Use a public manifest link for read-only import, or a trusted-device setup link copied from your own drive card for write sync on another device.
settings.addDriveGuideNameBody: This name is local to this device, so you can rename the same drive differently on each device.
settings.addDriveGuideAutoSyncBody: By default MUZERO syncs immediately after adding and keeps future local changes on automatic sync. You can switch to manual on the drive card.
settings.addDriveSyncAfterAddHint: Publish this device to the drive immediately after saving.
settings.addDriveAutoSyncAfterChangesHint: Future local edits sync after a short debounce. You can change this on the drive card.
settings.traceHint: Local playback diagnostics for the current app session. Reproduce the issue, then copy this log.
settings.traceReproEmpty: No user actions in this view.
settings.traceArchiveHint: {{count}} archived events · stored locally and rotated automatically
settings.importFoldersDesc: Remembered local folders are re-scanned on launch; new files are added automatically.
settings.importFoldersDesktopOnly: Folder watching is available in the desktop app.
settings.aboutWebOnly: You're on the web app — it updates automatically when you reload.
settings.llmModelEmpty: No models — type a model id
settings.llmModelIsDefault: This is the DJ's default model
settings.aiGenHint: Off by default. Generation uses a paid cloud API (BYOK). When on, the DJ can generate songs; search & ingest from streaming sources stays free either way.

recorder.reserved: This combo may be reserved by your OS / browser and might not fire.

recorder.chainHint: Resolving conflicts — record a new shortcut for each, or cancel.
recorder.blocked: Conflicts with a protected shortcut ({{names}}) — can't save.

set.deleteBody: Keep the songs (they stay in your other sets and in All songs), or also permanently delete songs that exist only in this set.

entity.deleteBody_one: Permanently delete its {{count}} song? It’s removed from every set too — this can’t be undone.
entity.deleteBody_other: Permanently delete its {{count}} songs? They’re removed from every set too — this can’t be undone.
